title: A library for the questions that stay with you
intro: Practical prompts, gentle reading, and grounded ways to reflect between conversations.

sections.heading: Start with your question
sections.body: Choose the resource that sounds closest to what you are carrying today.

sections.heading: Use what helps
sections.body: You do not need to read everything. One useful prompt is enough to begin.

sections.heading: Return to real life
sections.body: Every reflection should lead back to your relationships, choices, and wellbeing.
